## Release — backlog-campaign v0.25.1

### 🐛 Fixed in v0.25.1

#### Heavy campaign agents no longer thrash on auto-compaction

- `planner`, `implementer`, `investigator`, `hunter`, `orchestrator` and `reviewer` now run on `model: opus[1m]` and no longer cap auto-compaction at 100k tokens. In repos that inject a large base context into every subagent (about 155k tokens), these agents previously died with "Autocompact is thrashing". Measured on such a repo, a planner now reaches 302k tokens with 0 compactions, where it used to die at about 180k ([#1098](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1098)).
- A spawn-time `agent({ model })` override changes the model but not a plugin agent's context window. Only the agent's frontmatter `model` sets the window. `model-routing.md` now documents this.
- The `opus[1m]` model is set only in the Claude Code agents. The Cursor, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity and skills.sh agents keep their harness default model.
- These six agents now require access to the Opus 1M-context model.
